hack.root_cause: Missing signature verification in MinimalForwarder → unvalidated oracle price update → multi-chain drain
hack.description: KiloEx is a multi-chain perpetuals protocol backed by Binance Labs. Their oracle system used a chain of contract trust: . The contract accepted any forged signature with zero validation — anyone could submit arbitrary price updates.
